notes.title: Two Big Updates!
notes.notes:
We have two big updates for Forgebeast!

1) The Kickstarter has been successfully funded (and in 24 hours!)

We were pumped to see the positive support for the game, and we're planning on launching it in early access sometime next year. If you want to become a playtester, and help guide development, consider becoming a Backer! Playtesters will get the first look at the gameplay, and we're always looking for more testers to give us feedback.

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/digitalpiledriver/forgebeast]Check out the Kickstarter Here![/url]

2) We've revealed two more stretch goals, which add additional content to the game.

At $14,350, Tummy rub mode will be unlocked! What is it, you ask? At certain points between enemy encounters, there will be a random chance for a mini-game to appear. The player will need to calm their sleeping pet, which is having nightmares. If a player can successfully calm the Forgebeast (by performing actions to rub its tummy!), they'll receive a unique bonus to improve the bond with their Forgebeast.

At $17,350, the Arena Challenge will unlock. The arena challenge will be an additional game mode where players can show their skill by facing continual waves of enemies and compete against others for the top score. The longer the player survives, the stronger the enemies become. Bosses will also make an appearance at certain intervals in the arena mode.

You can find more info on the Kickstarter page!
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/digitalpiledriver/forgebeast]Forgebeast Kickstarter[/url]

Sincerely,

-The Forgebeast Team

notes.title: Forgebeast Kickstarter is Live!
notes.notes:
The team at Digital Piledriver Studios is happy to announce the Kickstarter for Forgebeast is now live!

If you want to support the game's development and be the first to get news and updates, consider becoming a backer! The Kickstarter touts a range of rewards for potential backers, including digital copies of the game, t-shirts, beta testing access, and even designing game elements like NPC's and enemies to be included in the game's release. 

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/digitalpiledriver/forgebeast]Check out the Kickstarter Here![/url]

We hope that we can leverage two of Kickstarter's biggest strengths: 1) Creating a community around a unique game/idea, and 2) Getting feedback to help make it a better game.

Sincerely,
The team at DPS
